summary: The note profiles Dr. Evelyn Chase of Chicago, a leading cybersecurity expert who applies AI and machine learning to detect and respond to cyber threats. It covers her ML training of systems, real-time detection, integration with blockchain, quantum computing and IoT, and predictive war-game simulations. It stresses human oversight and ethics, arguing that combining human intuition with machine intelligence is the strongest defense.
one_line: Profile of Dr. Evelyn Chase's work applying AI and machine learning to cybersecurity, including detection, predictive defense, blockchain integration and ethics.
key_facts: Dr. Evelyn Chase of Chicago is described as one of the premier cybersecurity experts worldwide who uses AI and ML against digital threats.
Dr. Chase addressed IT experts at the Chicago Cyber Security Summit on October 15th 2023, presenting work integrating AI with cybersecurity.
Her team trains machine learning systems on massive datasets of malware, ransomware and other intrusions so they can distinguish benign from malicious activity.
On December 1st 2023, Dr. Chase demonstrated ML algorithms that detected and quarantined an elaborate phishing attempt threatening Chicago City Council infrastructure.
In November 2023, her models quickly detected a zero-day vulnerability exploit attempt against a financial institution in Chicago, preventing a potentially catastrophic data breach.
Dr. Chase advocates integrating AI with blockchain for immutable transaction ledgers, quantum computing for rapid decryption and encryption, and IoT for device protection.
On January 3rd 2024, Dr. Chase unveiled a project combining AI with encrypted blockchain technology for secure, transparent and tamper-proof transactions.
At a webinar series on February 20, 2024, Dr. Chase stressed that AI should be seen only as a tool, not a replacement for humans, who retain nuanced judgment and ethical considerations.
Her teams use AI insights and alerts to inform strategic decisions, with a feedback loop in which humans and AI systems learn from each other.
She builds predictive models using global cyber incident reports to predict attack vectors and protect organizations against future breaches.
Her team is developing an initiative, set to launch by late 2024, using AI to simulate potential attacks as virtual war games.
Dr. Chase authored a widely respected AI ethics charter emphasizing transparency, accountability and respect for privacy norms.
